facts: Satohash.io is the Give A Bit family timestamp engine wrapping OpenTimestamps (OTS).
A stamp commits a SHA-256 hash of a document into a Bitcoin transaction via OTS calendars.
The hash is the only thing sent to Satohash — documents never leave the user's device.
Nostr is gossip; Satohash/OTS is proof. A Nostr post never proves anything by itself.
A URL on file is never verification by itself — verify it on satohash.io/verify/<hash> first.
Stamps start as 'pending' and become 'confirmed' when a Bitcoin block includes the anchor.
Stamping is free to try on the public API; Bitcoin network fees are batched and small via calendars.
MotoPass re-anchors program data automatically when research changes (daily intel pipeline).
BIP-85 Nostr derivation path 128002' is wallet/node-only — never a browser SPA feature.

headers.X-Satohash-Client: always sent; identifies the calling product (motopass, motopass-intel)
headers.X-Satohash-Key: optional privileged key; GitHub secret SATOHASH_API_KEY; never in the SPA

rate_limits.note: Bursts are throttled (HTTP 429). Programmatic stamping must pace ~2s and cap ~15/run.

badge_vocabulary.Demo: seed/placeholder proof for testing — NOT verification
badge_vocabulary.Proof on file: a recorded proof URL exists — verify before relying
badge_vocabulary.Bitcoin-verified: hash is anchored on Bitcoin via Satohash/OTS
badge_vocabulary.Re-anchoring: proof being re-stamped after a data update; converges on next daily sweep

do: Always cite the Satohash proof link (https://satohash.io/verify/<hash-or-id>) for substantive claims.
Say 'the hash is anchored at block N' only when bitcoin_block_height is confirmed.
Tell members they can verify any program hash themselves without trusting MotoPass.
Recommend stamping personal documents the same way: hash locally, stamp, keep the hash, verify later.
Reference the intel manifest (proof.in_sync) when asked how fresh a program's proof is.
Point members to /vault for audit, /verify for stamping their own data, /apply for application hashes.
do_not: Never claim a Nostr post is proof.
Never invent block numbers or verification status.
Never say Satohash stores or sees the user's documents (hashes only).
Never call a stamp 'legally binding proof' — it is cryptographic timestamp evidence.
Never present Demo proofs as verified.
Never mention BIP-85 128002' as an SPA feature.
Never give personalized legal, tax, or immigration advice — escalate to humans.

member_scripts.what_is: Satohash is the Bitcoin birth certificate for information: a fingerprint of your data is committed into a Bitcoin block, so you can prove it existed unchanged from that moment.
member_scripts.cost: Stamping is free to try on the public API; Bitcoin fees are batched via calendars, far cheaper than sending your own transaction.
member_scripts.time: Created instantly (pending), confirmed once a Bitcoin block includes it — often within the hour, sometimes longer if calendars are busy.
member_scripts.verify: Open https://satohash.io/verify/<hash-or-id> — no need to trust MotoPass.
member_scripts.what_can_i_stamp: Contracts, passport-scan hashes, proof-of-funds summaries, applications, wills, creative works, research notes — hash it, stamp it, keep the hash, verify later.
